view.chat.name: Chat

config.title: Sovereign Agent
config.provider: Local backend. Ollama uses its native API; all other presets use the local OpenAI-compatible API.
config.baseUrl: Server address. Leave empty to use the selected provider's default. Must be a local address.
config.model: Model name, for example `qwen2.5-coder:7b`. Use the **Select Model** command to pick from the server.
config.compareModel: Optional second local model. When set, every prompt is sent to both models in parallel so you can choose the better response.
config.asrBaseUrl: Local OpenAI-compatible ASR server address. Nemotron ASR servers commonly expose http://localhost:8000/v1.
config.asrModel: ASR model identifier, defaulting to nemotron-3.5-asr. Use the exact model id exposed by your local server.
config.language: Interface language. `auto` follows VS Code's display language. The agent also replies in this language when the message language is unclear.
config.temperature: Sampling temperature. Lower values are more predictable.
config.contextLength: Context window in tokens. Match this to the value your model was loaded with.
config.maxIterations: Maximum number of tool steps per message.
config.requireWriteApproval: Ask before the agent writes or overwrites a file.
config.requireCommandApproval: Ask before the agent runs a shell command.
config.tools: Workspace tools are always available to the local agent. File writes, replacements and shell commands require approval by default.
config.mcpServers: JSON map of local STDIO MCP servers. Servers start only after approval. Example: {"filesystem":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem","."]}}.
config.allowLanHosts: Allow servers on private LAN addresses (10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16-31.x, `*.local`). Off by default so nothing leaves your machine.
